(rule!
  (let* ((start (first (find-color g 2)))
         (goal (first (find-color g 3))))
    (define parent (make-hash))
    (define seen (make-hash))
    (define queue (list (cons (first start) (second start))))
    (define goal-key (cons (first goal) (second goal)))
    (define found #f)
    (hash-set! seen (first queue) #t)
    (let bfs ([step 0])
      (unless (or found (empty? queue))
        (let ((cur (first queue)))
          (set! queue (rest queue))
          (when (equal? cur goal-key) (set! found #t))
          (unless found
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                    (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc)))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 5)))
                  (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                  (hash-set! parent (cons nr nc) cur)
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc)))))))))
        (bfs (+ step 1))))
    (if (not found)
        g
        (let trace ([cur goal-key] [path (list)])
          (if (equal? cur (cons (first start) (second start)))
              (foldl (lambda (p out)
                       (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                           (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8)
                           out))
                     g
                     path)
              (trace (hash-ref parent cur) (cons (list (car cur) (cdr cur)) path)))))))
